researchProposals.queryTopic: modern Linux kernel eBPF syscall auditing capability-based sandboxing best practices
researchProposals.title: eBPF-Inspired Syscall Namespace Depth & Capability Audit Tagging
researchProposals.rationale: Modern Linux LSM and eBPF seccomp pipelines attach deterministic path-depth and namespace capability tags to every permitted syscall without allocating dynamic closures.
researchProposals.featureSpec: Return syscallAuditClass ("readonly" or "scratch_write") and canonicalDepth (number of resolved path segments) on valid syscall_router responses while keeping all null-byte, backslash, and root checks.
researchProposals.expectedBenefit: Enables zero-overhead syscall audit tracing and anomalies correlation.

sources.title: Linux Kernel LSM & Seccomp BPF Architecture

researchProposals.queryTopic: operating system slab memory allocator guard pages quarantine fragmentation mitigation
researchProposals.title: Hardened Slab Allocator Free-Headroom & Alignment Guard Telemetry
researchProposals.rationale: Hardened OS slab allocators track remaining heap headroom and page-alignment compliance on every allocation to detect fragmentation pressure early.
researchProposals.featureSpec: Include heapHeadroomBytes and pageAligned (boolean: bytes % 4096 === 0) telemetry fields on successful memory_allocator responses while preserving 16 MiB slab and 256 MiB heap caps.
researchProposals.expectedBenefit: Surfaces heap fragmentation & alignment drift prior to OOM faults.

citations: seL4 Foundation Whitepaper: Formal Kernel Verification

expertKnowledgeBase.topic: Predictive Neural Slab Compaction & MMU Page Coloring

expertKnowledgeBase.expertStandard: Linux XDP (eXpress Data Path) & Cilium BPF

expertKnowledgeBase.synthesis: Shared static tokens remain vulnerable if intercepted. Time-limited ephemeral nonces signed with Ed25519 capabilities enforce automatic lease revocation.

vulnerabilities.title: Exposed SMBv2/v3 NetBIOS File Sharing on Host (Port 445)
vulnerabilities.attackVector: Malicious NTLM Relay or malformed SMB negotiation frame over local network segment.
vulnerabilities.hostImpact: Potential credential theft, pass-the-hash or remote unauthenticated packet execution.
vulnerabilities.shieldMechanism: packet_firewall DPI filter validating SMB frame headers and dropping unauthenticated relay bursts.
vulnerabilities.remediationAction: Disable SMBv1, enforce SMB signing and isolate port 445 to trusted private subnets.

vulnerabilities.title: LLMNR & NetBIOS Name Resolution Broadcast Poisoning
vulnerabilities.attackVector: Rogue Responder on LAN answering multicast LLMNR (UDP 5355) / NBT-NS queries.
vulnerabilities.hostImpact: NTLMv2 password hashes broadcasted over cleartext LAN during failed DNS resolution.
vulnerabilities.shieldMechanism: packet_firewall intercepts multicast broadcast probes and directs queries to unicast DNS.
vulnerabilities.remediationAction: Disable LLMNR via Group Policy (Computer Config -> Admin Templates -> Network -> DNS Client).

vulnerabilities.title: NT Token Impersonation & UAC Filtered Token Privilege Escalation
vulnerabilities.attackVector: Secondary processes attempting token duplication or unvalidated SeImpersonatePrivilege exploitation.
vulnerabilities.hostImpact: Standard user token elevated to SYSTEM context through named pipe impersonation.
vulnerabilities.shieldMechanism: auth_vault enforces hardware enclave tokens with rotating 300s nonces and constant-time validation.
vulnerabilities.remediationAction: Set UAC to Always Notify and restrict SeImpersonatePrivilege to service accounts.

vulnerabilities.title: Unquoted Service Executable Path Traversal in Host Apps
vulnerabilities.attackVector: Placing an unquoted executable in space-delimited paths (e.g. C:\Program Files\App\service.exe).
vulnerabilities.hostImpact: Unauthorized binary spawned during Windows boot.
vulnerabilities.shieldMechanism: syscall_router canonicalizes all execution paths with strict quotation and boundary enforcement.
vulnerabilities.remediationAction: Wrap all third-party Windows Service ImagePaths with explicit quotes.

vulnerabilities.title: Unfiltered TCP SYN Flood Burst on Web Service (Port 80)
vulnerabilities.attackVector: Rapid burst of spoofed TCP SYN packets exhausting host network buffer backlog.
vulnerabilities.hostImpact: Apache/WAMP socket starvation, rendering host web applications unresponsive.
vulnerabilities.shieldMechanism: packet_firewall implements WFP-style pre-stack driver filter dropping abusive SYN bursts (0.02ms latency).
vulnerabilities.remediationAction: Enable Windows SYN attack protection in registry (SynAttackProtect = 2).
